design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 0 of parking_rate_increase_and_compliance (round 4).

STEP 0 — draw (scripts/draw_counts.py --task 0): {"prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [5, 5, 6, 4]}. Assignment: late fee assessment 6 factors, billing-error correction 5, retention concession 5, bring-current payment 4. Scope snapshot: no task claimed yet; this task claims parking_ext_billing_error_correction, parking_ext_late_fee_assessment, parking_ext_bring_current_payment, parking_ext_retention_concession and their four tools. Reserved for task 1 (draw: 2 prerequisites, factors [4, 6, 4]): the tow-redemption world — tow notice fee posting, full-balance redemption payment after a tow notice (owner=user) and a vehicle swap on file — none of which this task touches.

WHY A GOOD TEST. Graciela Fuentes calls only about her rent increase letter and asks to take some of the increase off (retention concession). The concession rule states that it is recorded only after the balance due stands at zero or below; the records show 240.00 owed (September rent unpaid after a declined AutoPay draft and retry, plus a 2025-08-20 late fee). Getting her current requires a payment whose amount is fixed only once every unpaid-past-grace period carries a late fee (September has none) and every late fee posted against a period paid within grace carries a correction (August's does not); the late fee in turn waits on that correction. So the agent must discover a 3-deep chain the customer never mentions, and compute four multi-factor numbers across parking ledger history, AutoPay drafts and the storage unit holding. Difficulty comes from reading policy and reconciling the ledger, never from picking tools (each problem has one tool).

PROBLEM TREE CARD. Root parking_ext_retention_concession (agent). Edges: (1) late fee -> correction, value_input on lf_pct, state form, sentence 'A late fee for an unpaid period is not posted until each earlier late fee that was charged against a period paid within its grace period carries a billing-error correction credit on the ledger.' (negated direction); only the correction policy's write books such a credit. Opening: late fee 2025-08-20 references the 2025-08-14 period paid 2025-08-18, no credit references it. (2) payment -> late fee, value_input on pay_balance, state form, 'The amount that brings a delinquent agreement current is worked out only once a late fee stands on the ledger for every billing period whose rent remained unpaid past its grace period.' Opening: 2025-09-14 rent unpaid, grace ended 2025-09-19, no late fee for it. Only the late-fee policy books late fees. (3) payment -> correction, value_input on pay_balance, 'The amount that brings a delinquent agreement current is not fixed until every late fee posted against a period paid within its grace period carries a billing-error correction credit.' (4) concession -> payment, state_gate on parking_rentals.balance_due, 'A retention concession is recorded only after the agreement's balance due stands at zero or below.' Opening balance 240.00; the tenant's own payment (owner=user, debit card) is the write that brings it to zero or below (a correction credit alone, 62.05, cannot). Topological order: correction -> late fee -> payment -> concession; every pair is joined by an edge so the order is unique. Four-point test: each sentence has an ordering connective (not until / only once / not ... until / only after), waits on a record-visible state (credit entry, late-fee entry, balance due), names no tool/id/code token, and states a hard requirement scoped exactly as the condition. Directions mix affirmative and negated. Deletion sensitivity (sim run): skip correction -> late fee 20.20 (vs 16.0), payment 448.20 (balance 260.20 instead of 193.95), concession 212.02; skip late fee -> payment 365.95; skip payment -> balance stays 193.95, no payment row. The persona never mentions any prerequisite; tools validate none.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Correction (parking_credit): parking_evt_late_fee_and_waiver.not_already_credited — no credit references the August fee. Late fee (parking_fee_charge): grace_expired (anchor 2025-09-14 period_start, 5 calendar days counted from the day after, exclusive: allowed from 2025-09-20; 2025-10-08 qualifies), fee_status (delinquent is allowed). Payment (parking_payment): parking_evt_tow_process.full_payment_after_tow_notice — the agreement is delinquent, not tow_noticed, so any amount is accepted; parking_agg_portfolio_increase_review policy scope. Concession (parking_rate_change_notice): rate_increase first_increase_wait (start 2022-03-14 + 9 months), interval_wait (2024-02-14 + 12 months = 2025-02-14), no_prepay_lock (only prepaid plan completed 2023-03-13), increase_status retired by the declared overwrite (the concession's standing test is the zero balance); retention_concession concession_window (2025-09-02 + 45 days, last day 2025-10-17 included), concession_tenure (42 months >= 12), one_concession_per_increase (no concession or rescission references the increase).

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Correction targets late fee entry for period 2025-08-14 (reference_entry_id); the December 2024 late fee is excluded (paid 2024-12-23, after grace). Late fee targets the 2025-09-14 rent charge. Payment targets agreement P-214 balance. Concession targets the 2025-09-02 increase (source_rate_change_id); the 2024 increase is in effect and excluded.

FACTOR CARD (sim_t0.py on the handling-time worlds).
Correction 62.05 = 30.00 + MN(25.00, 0.05 x 220.50 x 2) + 10.00; baseline (standard 2% of 210.00 capped at 10.00, no allowance) 34.20. Per factor baseline results: share 48.82, rent measure 61.00, multiplier 51.03, ceiling 50.00, allowance 52.05. Multi-source: share (tenure AND payments). Cross-difficulty: bundled multiplier (unit E108).
Late fee 16.0 = MX(10.00, 31.50 x 1.25 x 16/30 - 5.00); baseline (greater of 30.00 flat and 12% of rent, capped 60.00, in full) 30.00. Factor baselines: percentage 15.00, cycle 11.80, anchor 19.94, proration 34.38, rebate 21.00, minimum 30.00. Cross-difficulty: anchor (AutoPay drafts, latest declined attempt 2025-09-17) and rebate (unit). Near-miss: the first declined attempt 2025-09-14 is not the anchor; the latest declined attempt is.
Payment 381.95 = 193.95 + 210.00 - 10.00 - 5.00 - 7.00; baseline (balance as booked) 193.95. Factor baselines: next period 171.95, loyal deferral 391.95, bundle deferral 386.95, lockout deferral 388.95.
Concession 211.22 = floor-cent(220.50 - MN(15.00, (0.55 + 0.05 - 0.02) x 16.00)); baseline (50% of 10.50 capped at 8.00) 215.25. Factor baselines: share 212.02, bundle 212.02, AutoPay adjustment 210.90, measure 214.41, ceiling 212.50. The measure tier: rent last changed 2024-02-14, 18 whole months before the 2025-09-02 notice -> noticed increase plus half the 2023-12-20 increase. The AutoPay adjustment: the Debit Card authorization was suspended 2025-09-17 after two consecutive failed due dates, as the AutoPay charter requires (consecutive_failures_to_suspend 2), so the lapsed-AutoPay reduction applies. Near-miss: three late fees stand in 12 months at handling time, but the corrected August fee does not count, keeping the loyal tier.

OVERWRITES. late fee: base 'The late fee is the greater of late_fee_flat_usd and late_fee_pct_of_rent times the monthly rent, rounded to the cent, capped at late_fee_max_usd.' replaced by the extended order sentence. Concession: base 'A tenant who calls about a noticed increase may be given a retention_concession that gives back retention_concession_pct_of_increase ...' and 'Increase notices go only to agreements in active status.' replaced. Correction: base 'A late fee posted against a period paid within grace is a billing error and is credited as billing_error_correction without using the courtesy allowance.' replaced by the correction order sentence (the credit is the fee plus service recovery and any allowance; the billing-error definition and the courtesy-allowance exemption are restated in the correction scope sentence).

SEED. 13 monthly rent charges (2024-09-14..2025-09-14, 210.00), 12 payments (10 AutoPay, two online), two late fees, one lockout notice, the 2023-12-20 (effective 2024-02-14) and 2025-09-02 increases plus a defective 2023-05-02 increase (199.00 -> 225.00, over the 9% cap) rescinded in full on 2023-05-20 (no rent change; excluded from the 24-month increase window), 17 AutoPay drafts (seven declined for insufficient funds: 2024-12-14 with retries 12-17 and 12-20, 2025-08-14 with retry 08-17, 2025-09-14 with retry 09-17; the authorization suspended 2025-09-17), active storage unit E108, a completed 2022 prepaid plan. Balance 240.00 equals the ledger. Automatic clauses: the gate lockout at 10 days after due is already sent; the tow notice is not yet due (from 2025-10-14) so nothing else is owed.

PERSONA. Dry, retired logistics sergeant; volunteers only the increase letter and the ask; identity, space, unit, September/August facts only on request; pays exactly the quoted amount with her debit card when handed the payment; closes on hearing the new November rent.

STANDARD SOLUTION. Locate by phone, verify (phone + ZIP), read the agreement, rate changes, ledger, notices, AutoPay enrollment and drafts, unit rentals and prepaid plans; credit 62.05 against the August fee; post the September late fee 16.0; hand over the payment of 381.95 by debit card; record the concession rent 211.22.

VERIFICATION. /tmp/run_0051/parking_rate_increase_and_compliance/sim_t0.py replays the gold writes with the real tools and evaluates each compute on its handling-time world through check_compute's own evaluator; output equals computations and gold. Draft recomputation from visible text only (rules, docstrings, ledger): the same chain and the same four figures.

ROUND 2 REVISIONS (policy-task audit). T0-1/F1: symptom two credit amounts (30.00 vs 62.05); root cause undeclared override of the base billing-error sentence; change: declared overwrite on parking_ext_billing_error_correction; re-run: credit 62.05 unchanged, base reading retired. F7: rule now says corrections are made on the most recently posted late fee and the ceiling counts late fees with the corrected one included (no 'minus one'); figures unchanged. F6: lateness anchor sentence now names the delinquency date and the agreement's own drafts (compute filters drafts by agreement); 16.00 unchanged. T0-2: AutoPay seed made charter-consistent (August retry 08-17, December retries, suspended 2025-09-17, no next draft date); the concession's AutoPay factor redesigned (clean active share / lapsed reduction / nothing) so a bounced authorization never earns more than none; concession 210.66 -> 211.22. T0-3/F5: close-increase threshold moved to 18 months so every tier is reachable on interval-12 classes; prior increase reseeded 2023-12-20 / effective 2024-02-14 so this world takes the middle tier (16.00). T0-4: the payment<-correction load-bearing figure restated (448.20 with balance 260.20; 444.00 if the late fee were held). Gates re-run green.

ROUND 3 REVISION (charter finding N1). Symptom: the round-2 correction rule ('billing errors are corrected on the agreement's most recently posted late fee') disagreed with the late-fee and payment prerequisite sentences ('each/every late fee charged against a period paid within its grace period carries a billing-error correction credit') whenever an erroneous fee is followed by a legitimate one. Root cause: the credit amount was read as the latest late fee, so the rule was narrowed to fit the formula. Change: the correction scope now covers each erroneous late fee (matching the prerequisite sentences word for word in substance), and the credit is built on the agreement's standard late fee (the greater of the flat fee and the standard percentage of the contracted rent, capped), which the formula computes without depending on which fee is corrected; the service-recovery ceiling counts late fees of any kind in the last 12 months. Re-run: correction 62.05 (standard fee 30.00 = the August fee as posted), late fee 16.00, payment 381.95, concession 211.22, every factor and load-bearing figure unchanged. No scored value moved.

ROUND 4 REVISION (KB-audit policy-side notes). (1) The concession's declared override of the base sentence 'Increase notices go only to agreements in active status.' now has a replacement in kind: the concession rule restates that increase notices go only to active agreements and says that standing requirement governs the sending of a notice, not the recording of a concession on an increase already noticed (previously the replacement was the balance prerequisite sentence, a different subject). (2) The bring-current deferrals were worded permissively ('may leave'); they are now stated as applied ('has ... left on the next statement'), so the payment has one reading: 381.95. (3) The AutoPay read objective now says the authorization is suspended (2025-09-17), and the source_rate_change_id tracing gives the 2023-12-20 increase's effective date as 2024-02-14, as the record does. No scored value moved: 62.05 / 16.00 / 381.95 / 211.22.
user_scenario:
You are Graciela Fuentes, a retired Air Force logistics sergeant in Phoenix who keeps her 26-foot travel trailer in a covered space at the Bluegate facility on the north side. You are calling the Bluegate tenant care line because a letter dated September 2 says the rent on your trailer space is going from $210.00 to $220.50 a month starting with the November 14 bill. You are not angry, just tired of every bill creeping up, and you open by saying you got the rent increase letter for your trailer space and you would like to know whether they can take some of that increase off so you can keep the trailer there. You are happy for the agent to set up whatever break they can give you on the space; you do not want to move the trailer and you are not asking to cancel anything.

You speak plainly and a little dryly, with the habit of reading numbers back slowly. You do not offer your details up front. When the agent asks who you are, you give your name and your cell number, 4805552147, and if they want something more you give the billing ZIP code on your account, 85023. If they ask which space, it is space P-214 at the Phoenix store, the covered RV space, and the trailer is your travel trailer with plate 22K-917T. Your email, if they ask for it, is graciela.fuentes@outlook.com.

You honestly have not looked at the account in a while because the rent goes out automatically on your debit card. Only if the agent brings up September or a balance do you say that you got an email from the bank about the card being short in mid-September and assumed it would sort itself out. Only if the agent asks you about August do you say you paid August online yourself a few days after the automatic payment bounced, on the 18th. If the agent asks whether you rent anything else from Bluegate, you mention your storage unit, E108, at the same facility, which you have had since 2021. You do not know any of Bluegate's rules about fees or offers and you never suggest what they should do.

If the agent explains that something has to be paid on the space and tells you the amount, you agree to pay it right now with your debit card, and once the agent hands the payment over to you, you make the payment for exactly the amount the agent told you, from your debit card, and read back the confirmation you get. You do not haggle over the figure the agent quotes for the payment. If the agent tells you about any correction or fee they have put on the account, you simply say "all right" and let them carry on.

When the agent tells you what your rent will be from November after the break they give you, you repeat the figure back, thank them, and end the call. If the agent says they cannot reduce the increase at all, you say that is disappointing but you understand, and you end the call.

edges.condition: Every late fee on the agreement whose billing period was paid within its grace period carries a billing-error correction credit entry referencing it.
edges.policy_source: A late fee for an unpaid period is not posted until each earlier late fee that was charged against a period paid within its grace period carries a billing-error correction credit on the ledger.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The 2025-08-20 late fee stands against the 2025-08-14 period paid 2025-08-18 (inside grace) and no billing-error correction credit references it.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The correction credit referencing the August fee is booked; the uncorrected late-fee count falls from 2 to 1 and the late-fee percentage from 0.18 to 0.15.

edges.condition: A late fee entry referencing the rent charge stands on the ledger for every billing period whose rent is unpaid past its grace period.
edges.policy_source: The amount that brings a delinquent agreement current is worked out only once a late fee stands on the ledger for every billing period whose rent remained unpaid past its grace period.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The 2025-09-14 rent is unpaid past its grace period and no late fee entry references it.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The late fee of 16.0 referencing the September rent charge is posted, raising the balance due.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The order is fully fixed by the edges: the late fee waits on the correction (its percentage reads the uncorrected late-fee count), the payment waits on both (its balance includes both), the concession waits on the payment. Every pair of writes is joined by an edge, so no two writes may swap: BC before LF changes LF from 20.20 to 16.00; LF and BC before PAY change PAY (448.20 without BC, 365.95 without LF).

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the correction: late fee 20.2 instead of 16.0 (percentage 0.18), payment 448.2 instead of 381.95, concession 212.02 instead of 211.22, and no correction credit row.
Skipping the late fee: payment 365.95 instead of 381.95, and no late fee row on the ledger.

Skipping the correction (and recomputing the late fee on that world, 20.20): payment 448.2 instead of 381.95, from a balance of 260.20 (240.00 + 20.20) instead of 193.95; with the late fee held at 16.00 the payment would be 444.00, also different.
Skipping the payment: no payment row, balance due stays 193.95 instead of -188.00, so the concession is recorded on an account that is not current (terminal state differs).
